name: Datenshi-tachi no Shokkan
source:
Shinseiki Evangelion parody game. Mystery perverts appear at the train line. Asuka and Hikari receive a mission to repel the perverts. They have to follow Misato instructions to stand a chance against delinquents. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《新世纪福音战士》的恶搞游戏。神秘色狼出现在铁路线附近。明日香和洞木光接到驱逐色狼的任务。她们必须听从葛城美里的指示，才有机会对付那些不良分子。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
